skill.name: setup
skill.description: Guides project initialization for Claude Code and Codex workflows. It selects setup steps, scaffolds common files, and generates CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, Plans.md, and Claude settings.
skill.summary: Initialize project workflow files and Claude Code settings from project context.
skill.author: Chachamaru127

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, Japanese text, and protective deny-list documentation. I confirmed the hidden-plugin shell execution path in adaptive setup and added semantic findings for permission-bypass and overbroad allowlist guidance. The author should narrow permission defaults and avoid encouraging bypass modes before publication.

remediation.issue: Permission bypass is presented as the preferred default.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the default bypassPermissions recommendation, keep disableBypassPermissionsMode available, and require explicit user confirmation for any bypass mode.

remediation.issue: Wildcard MCP and broad Bash allow rules are too permissive.
remediation.suggestion: Replace wildcard grants with project-specific allow entries and keep risky package scripts behind ask or deny rules.

remediation.issue: Adaptive setup executes a script from a hidden plugin path.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve the plugin path from a trusted install root, validate the script location, and show the command before execution.

content.user_title: Initialize Claude and Codex Project Workflows
content.value_statement: New projects often lack consistent AI workflow files and setup rules. This skill guides setup, scaffolding, and settings generation for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code projects.
actual_capabilities: Classifies setup requests and routes them to focused setup sub-skills.
Analyzes project state before choosing new-project or existing-project setup.
Prompts users when project type is ambiguous instead of guessing.
Generates AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and Plans.md from project context.
Scaffolds common project directories and starter configuration files.
Creates or merges .claude/settings.json with permission policy guidance.
limitations: Some flows can run Bash commands or local plugin scripts.
Generated Claude settings require security review before use.
The skill does not install dependencies without user confirmation.
It targets Claude Code harness workflows and may need adaptation elsewhere.

use_cases.title: Start an AI-ready project
use_cases.description: Create starter files and workflow documents for a new Claude Code or Codex project.

use_cases.title: Standardize team setup
use_cases.description: Generate shared AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and Plans.md files for consistent AI-assisted work.

use_cases.title: Repair missing workflow files
use_cases.description: Add missing setup files to an existing repository without overwriting user work.

prompt_templates.title: Set up a new project
prompt_templates.prompt: Initialize this repository for a new Claude Code and Codex workflow. Ask before overwriting any existing file.

prompt_templates.title: Add workflow files
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and Plans.md for this existing project. Use the detected technology stack.

prompt_templates.title: Scaffold project structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Scaffold a minimal web application structure for my selected stack. Show created files and skip dependency installation.

prompt_templates.title: Merge Claude settings
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the current .claude settings, merge the safe policy template, and explain any permission changes before writing files.

output_examples.input: A new TypeScript web project needs AI workflow files.
output: Created a plan for AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and Plans.md.
Detected TypeScript and selected web workflow sections.
Asked before writing files that already existed.

output_examples.input: An existing repository has partial Claude Code settings.
output_examples.output: The skill reports the current settings state, proposes a merge, and lists permission changes for review.

output: The skill asks whether the project is new or existing.
Setup continues only after the user chooses a project type.

best_practices: Review generated permission settings before enabling them in a real repository.
Commit shared workflow files, but keep local settings out of version control.
Run setup in a clean branch so changes are easy to inspect.
anti_patterns: Do not enable bypass permissions without a project-specific security review.
Do not use generated settings as a substitute for repository policy.
Do not run setup scripts from untrusted plugin paths.

faq.question: Does this skill create files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can write workflow files, settings files, and starter project structure when the user approves the setup flow.

faq.question: Does it work with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports Codex-oriented workflow files such as AGENTS.md, alongside Claude and Claude Code files.

faq.question: Will it overwrite existing files?
faq.answer: The documented flow asks before overwriting and prefers merges or additions for existing projects.

faq.question: Does it install dependencies?
faq.answer: No. The scaffolder says dependency installation should wait for user confirmation.

faq.question: Why is security review important?
faq.answer: The settings generator discusses permission bypass and broad tool allowlists, so teams should review those choices.

faq.question: What projects fit best?
faq.answer: It fits repositories that need AI coding workflow files, project setup guidance, or Claude Code settings.
